name: @red-cup-engineering/mint-authorization-request-service
description: Turn a resolved OAuth client record, a redirect_uri, and a PKCE code_challenge into a pending authorization record keyed by a fresh state token. Use it at the GET /oauth/authorize resource, after the caller has looked up the client but before it hands the browser to the upstream IdP (see the sibling google-oauth-services-section for that hop).
